visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a person's hands holding a dark, circular chocolate pastry with a distinctive cracked surface and white sugar crystals. In the background, there are three loaves of dark brown bread resting on a wooden board near a window with white blinds. (2) A mechanical stand mixer with a white body and a stainless steel hook is shown rotating rapidly, kneading a thick, smooth, dark brown chocolate dough inside a metal bowl under bright kitchen lighting. (3) The scene shifts to a marble countertop where a person uses a plastic scraper to divide and shape the dark dough. Nearby, a digital kitchen scale and a calculator are visible, indicating a precise and organized workspace. (4) The hands are seen flattening small portions of the dough into discs and rolling others into balls. The person places a darker piece of dough onto a lighter one, carefully folding the edges to encase the filling. (5) The prepared dough balls are pressed into granulated sugar on a white plate, ensuring the top surface is completely coated with white crystals before being placed on a metal baking tray lined with parchment paper. (6) A camera flash effect transitions to a shot of the pastries inside a professional-grade oven with a digital display. The pastries are seen rising and developing deep, natural cracks as they bake in the warm, artificial glow. (7) Finally, the baked pastries are displayed on a light blue plate. The person's hand reaches out to tap the hard, crispy surface of a pastry, demonstrating its texture against the background of the dark bread loaves.

The music has a bright, bouncy quality with a consistent BPM around 128. (2) A mechanical whirring sound with a steady, low-frequency hum enters the mix, indicating a motorized appliance in operation. This sound is layered beneath the continuous BGM and lasts for approximately two seconds before stopping abruptly. (3) Sharp, percussive thudding sounds are heard in a rapid sequence, followed by the sound of plastic scraping against a hard, resonant surface. These incidental noises are crisp and clear, signifying dough handling. (4) Multiple soft, muffled thudding sounds occur as if objects are being pressed or rolled, coinciding with the rhythmic pulse of the background music. The spectral bandwidth of these sounds is narrow. (5) A distinct electronic notification chime, consisting of two high-pitched beeps, is followed by a loud metallic clunk and the sound of a door handle clicking. These SFX are prominent in the mix. (6) The video concludes with a series of sharp, high-frequency tapping sounds, resembling fingernails hitting a hard, hollow shell. This is followed by a final musical flourish and a brief silence.
